title: Calculating Hodge and weight filtrations on localizations
summary: We describe the Macaulay2 package MixedHodgeModules, which computes Hodge and weight filtrations on localizations S_f of a polynomial ring S at a non-constant reduced polynomial f, as well as on twisted localizations S_f f^{-α}, where α\in QQ is rational. The package includes functionality for computing Hodge ideals, weighted Hodge ideals, higher multiplier ideals, generation levels of Hodge filtrations, weight levels of elements, p-functions, and lengths of weight filtrations.
